title: MoneyUa for Create:Numismatics
description: A retexture of Create:Numismatics money to Ukrainian hryvnia
body:
A retexture of Create:Numismatics money to Ukrainian hryvnia.
The resourse pack changes textures for cogs and spurs.
Spurs are changed to coins and coin stacks.
And Cogs are changed to paper money. Of 1 2 and 500 hryvnias
